annotations.title: Suggest questions to track for a product

description: Returns template questions a citation check could ask about a product, from its name, category and competitors: "What is the best …?", "… vs …". Questions the product already tracks are left out. Show them to the owner to choose from. It saves nothing, runs no check, and calls no AI, so it costs nothing. Without a category it offers questions about the brand only, because it will not invent a market for the product.

category.description: What kind of thing it is, as a buyer would say it, such as "WordPress SEO plugin".

name.description: The product. Falls back to the site’s own name.

prompts.description: Questions already tracked, to leave out.
